What is the name of this characteristic?

options.text: growth
nutrition
respiration
sensitivity

questions.questionText: Which statement describes the net movement of particles during diffusion?

options.text: from higher to lower concentration down a concentration gradient
from higher to lower concentration against a concentration gradient
from lower to higher concentration down a concentration gradient
from lower to higher concentration against a concentration gradient

questions.questionText:
What are the smaller basic units of starch and glycogen molecules?
starch glycogen

options.text: amino acids fatty acids and glycerol
amino acids glucose
glucose fatty acids and glycerol
glucose glucose

questions.questionText: Which statement describes the effect of temperature on enzymes?

options.text: High temperatures denature enzymes making it difficult for substrate molecules to fit into the active site.
High temperatures denature enzymes making it easy for substrate molecules to fit into the active site.
Low temperatures denature enzymes making it difficult for substrate molecules to fit into the active site.
Low temperatures denature enzymes making it easy for substrate molecules to fit into the active site.

questions.questionText: How do the air spaces in the spongy mesophyll of a leaf help to adapt it for photosynthesis?

options.text: They act as a store of oxygen.
They allow carbon dioxide gas to diffuse through the leaf more rapidly.
They increase the surface area for absorption of light energy.
They let rainwater enter the leaf tissues.

questions.questionText: What is the dietary importance of fibre in humans?

options.text: for growth and repair of cells
to help food move through the alimentary canal
to maintain strong bones and teeth
to provide energy

questions.questionText: In which part of the alimentary canal does ingestion take place?

options.text: anus
liver
mouth
stomach

questions.questionText: What is a function of the lymphatic system?

options.text: absorption of glucose
blood clotting
circulation of body fluids
temperature regulation

options.text: antibody
antigen

options.text: ciliated cells
goblet cells
nerve cells
white blood cells

process thorax pressure thorax volume air movement

questions.questionText:
Which statement correctly explains the difference in glucose concentration in the kidney tubule
between X and Y?
glomerulus X Y
kidney tubule

options.text: The glucose concentration is higher at X than at Y because glucose moves out of the kidney tubule by osmosis.
The glucose concentration is higher at X than at Y because glucose has been actively transported out of the kidney tubule.
The glucose concentration is higher at Y than at X because glucose diffuses into the kidney tubule.
The glucose concentration is higher at Y than at X because glucose is actively transported into the kidney tubule.

questions.questionText: Which sequence of structures does a pollen tube grow through in a flower?

options.text: ovary  ovule  stigma  style
ovary  stigma  ovule  style
stigma  style  ovary  ovule
stigma  ovary  style  ovule

questions.questionText: What is needed in the cytoplasm to make proteins at a ribosome?

options.text: DNA and amino acids
DNA only
mRNA and amino acids
mRNA only

questions.questionText: Which adaptation is shown in the leaves of hydrophytes?

options.text: hairs present on the upper and lower surfaces
contain large air spaces
stomata present on the lower surface only
thick cuticle present on the upper and lower surfaces

questions.questionText:
Sickle cell anaemia is a genetic disorder which results in severe illness in homozygous
individuals. In some human populations, being heterozygous can be beneficial.
What could be the reason for this?

options.text: Heterozygous individuals are not affected by the disorder.
Heterozygous individuals are more resistant to malaria.
The disorder is caused by a dominant allele.
The disorder is sex-linked.

questions.questionText: Which statement about selective breeding is correct?

options.text: It does not involve humans.
It involves a struggle for survival.
It always involves only one parent.
It involves parents that possess desirable features.

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows the water cycle. Four different processes are numbered.
Which row identifies the processes correctly?
condensation evaporation precipitation transpiration

A herd of red deer live in a forest that contains snakes and a large variety of birds.
Which group of organisms is an example of a population?

options.text: all the animals in the forest
all the red deer in the forest
all the organisms in the forest
all the plants in the forest

questions.questionText: With which kingdoms do bacteria share the same genetic code?

options.text: animal, plant, fungus and protoctist
animal, plant and fungus only
animal and plant only
animal only

questions.questionText: Which process makes use of a genetically engineered organism?

options.text: using bacteria to produce insulin
using enzymes in biological washing powders
using pectinase in fruit juice production
using yeast to produce ethanol

questions.questionText: What is a reason for conserving plant species?

options.text: to absorb oxygen from the air
to decrease rainfall
to obtain drugs for medicinal use
to release carbon dioxide into the air

questions.questionText:
The food web shows the feeding relationships in a woodland.
sparrowhawks
chaffinches
grey wood
squirrels pigeons
caterpillars
trees
If all the chaffinches in the food web die, which effect would this have?

options.text: The amount of damage to trees will increase.
The food supply for grey squirrels will increase.
The number of wood pigeons will increase.

The population of caterpillars will decrease.
